intro: A visual tour of the MVP running on clearly-labelled demo data: every module, real role-based access, both themes and phone layouts. All figures, people and schools shown are fictional seed data.
footer: Integral Academy · Executive Workspace MVP · screenshots captured from a production build running on demo data.

sections.title: Sign-in
sections.lede: Private to management and staff. Sessions are database-backed and revocable; sign-ins are rate-limited and audited.

shots.title: Sign-in page
shots.caption: The crest on paper, as in print, beside a dark sign-in panel. Unauthenticated visitors to any page land here and return to where they were going.

sections.title: Executive dashboard
sections.lede: What management needs to know and act on today.
points: KPIs: revenue, active learners, MRR, churn, school partnerships, cash & runway — each with a period comparison
Revenue by stream and learner growth with 7d / 30d / 3m / 6m / 12m ranges
Action centre: pending approvals, overdue tasks, deadlines, critical issues

shots.title: Dashboard — Super Admin, dark theme
shots.caption: Announcements, KPI cards, charts with a table view, pipeline, action centre, strategic objectives, department snapshots and recent activity.

shots.title: Dashboard — light theme
shots.caption: The same dashboard in the light theme, as seen by the Finance Executive; widgets follow each role's permissions.

sections.title: Business intelligence
sections.lede: Seven analysis tabs with a server-side period filter, period-over-period comparisons and CSV exports.
points: Overview, learners, subscriptions & revenue, schools, marketing, academic, financial KPIs
Finance figures are removed on the server for roles without finance access

shots.title: Overview
shots.caption: Revenue, MRR, active and paying learners, churn, schools won, cash and runway, each compared with the previous period.

shots.title: Learners
shots.caption: Learner base, sign-ups vs paid cancellations, and breakdowns by province and plan.

shots.title: Schools
shots.caption: Pipeline conversion by stage, schools won vs lost, contracted partnership MRR and renewals.

shots.title: Marketing
shots.caption: Spend, leads and conversions; cost per lead and per conversion by channel and campaign.

shots.title: Financial KPIs
shots.caption: Gross margin, cost of revenue, operating expenses, net burn, runway and cash trend.

shots.title: Same tab, Marketing Executive
shots.caption: Without finance access the financial tab shows a notice instead of numbers; the data is never sent.

sections.title: Approvals
sections.lede: Formal sign-off for expenses, purchases, contracts, campaigns, releases and strategic decisions, with a permanent decision record.

shots.title: Approval queue
shots.caption: Pending, approved, rejected and changes-requested, with priority, amount and due date. Expenses over R5,000 are routed here automatically.

shots.title: Approval detail
shots.caption: Business case, linked record, decision panel (approve / reject / request changes with a comment) and the full decision history. Nobody can approve their own request.

sections.title: Tasks
sections.lede: Personal, department and company task lists with projects, priorities, due dates and links to meetings, schools, features and bugs.

shots.title: Task list
shots.caption: Scoped views, filters, sorting and pagination done in the database.

shots.title: Task detail
shots.caption: Status, assignee, links and document attachments; meeting action items appear here automatically.

sections.title: Finance
sections.lede: Income, expenses, cash flow, budgets and projections in Rand.

shots.title: Financial overview
shots.caption: Revenue, expenses, net, receivables and payables, cash position, runway, monthly P&L and expenses by category.

shots.title: Cash flow
shots.caption: Monthly or annual cash in vs cash out and the closing balance, with the full statement table.

shots.title: Budgets vs actual
shots.caption: Department budgets with spend to date, variance and burn-down.

shots.title: Projections
shots.caption: Conservative / Base / Aggressive scenarios from editable assumptions (growth, churn, pricing, school deals, costs).

shots.title: Expenses — light theme
shots.caption: Expense register with approval status; large expenses wait for approval before they can be paid.

sections.title: Schools & partnerships
sections.lede: A CRM for the school pipeline: Lead → Contacted → Meeting → Proposal → Negotiation → Won / Lost.

shots.title: Pipeline board
shots.caption: Drag-and-drop (or menu) stage moves, values, follow-up reminders and overdue flags.

shots.title: School profile
shots.caption: Contacts, partnership terms and renewal, notes, meetings, tasks and documents for one school.

sections.title: Marketing
sections.lede: Campaigns with budgets, assigned teams, weekly performance and approvals.

shots.title: Campaigns
shots.caption: Spend, leads, conversions and cost per lead across campaigns and channels, plus a campaign calendar.

shots.title: Campaign detail
shots.caption: Weekly spend and lead trends, budget burn, team and recorded metrics.

sections.title: Academic
sections.lede: Content production and tutoring.

shots.title: Content pipeline
shots.caption: Idea → Planned → Recording → Editing → Review → Approved → Published, with learner engagement from the learner platform.

shots.title: Tutor hours
shots.caption: Tutors log hours; the Head Tutor approves or rejects them in bulk (never their own).

sections.title: Product & technology
sections.lede: Roadmap, bugs and development tasks for the learner platform.

shots.title: Roadmap
shots.caption: Backlog → Planned → In progress → Testing → Released, with linked open bugs.

shots.title: Bug tracker
shots.caption: Severity, status and assignment; critical and high bugs alert the product team.

sections.title: Team
sections.lede: Directory, reporting lines and headcount. Salaries and performance are visible only to authorised roles.

shots.title: Team directory
shots.caption: Cost to company is shown here because this role has sensitive team access; most roles never receive it from the server.

sections.title: Documents
sections.lede: The company repository: folders, versions, tags, previews and access control.

shots.title: Repository
shots.caption: Folder tree by category, search, tags and access levels (all staff, department, executive, restricted).

shots.title: Document preview
shots.caption: In-browser PDF/image/text preview, version history with checksums, and permission-checked downloads.

sections.title: Meetings
sections.lede: Board, executive, departmental and school meetings.

shots.title: Meetings
shots.caption: Upcoming and past meetings with decisions and action-item progress.

shots.title: Meeting record
shots.caption: Agenda and notes, recorded decisions, attendance, RSVPs, and action items that become tasks in each owner's list.

sections.title: Calendar
sections.lede: Every dated item the viewer may see, in South African time.

shots.title: Month view
shots.caption: Meetings, task deadlines, approvals, follow-ups, payments, campaigns, content and releases, filterable by kind; an agenda view is one click away.

sections.title: Strategy
sections.lede: Annual company objectives and the quarterly priorities that roll up to them.

shots.title: Objectives
shots.caption: On track / At risk / Delayed / Completed, with live values for metric-linked goals (learners, MRR, schools, runway).

shots.title: Objective detail
shots.caption: Progress, check-in history and quarterly children.

sections.title: Search & notifications
sections.lede: Global search (⌘K) across everything the user may see, and a notification centre.

shots.title: Search results
shots.caption: Grouped results with highlighted matches.

shots.title: Notifications
shots.caption: Assignments, approval requests and decisions, deadlines, documents, meetings and announcements.

sections.title: Administration
sections.lede: Users, roles, the audit trail and company announcements.

shots.title: Users
shots.caption: Create users with a one-time temporary password, change roles, suspend or offboard (sessions revoked), reset passwords and unlock accounts.

shots.title: Roles & permissions
shots.caption: The nine roles and their permissions, defined in code and checked against the database.

shots.title: Audit log
shots.caption: Who did what and when, with filters, previous/new value diffs and CSV export. The log is append-only.

shots.title: Announcements
shots.caption: Company-wide notices shown on everyone's dashboard, with scheduling and expiry.

sections.title: Profile & security
sections.lede: Every user manages their own password and signed-in devices.

shots.title: Profile
shots.caption: Change password, see every signed-in device and sign out the others. People given a temporary password must set their own before using anything else.

sections.title: On a phone
sections.lede: The urgent things first: KPIs, approvals, tasks, notifications and meetings.

shots.title: Dashboard
shots.caption: KPIs, then the action centre, then my tasks & meetings.

shots.title: Approvals
shots.caption: Review and decide from anywhere.

shots.title: Tasks
shots.caption: Your work, filtered.

shots.title: Meetings
shots.caption: Today's and upcoming meetings.

shots.title: Notifications
shots.caption: What changed and what needs you.

sections.title: Role-based access
sections.lede: Nine roles with fine-grained permissions enforced on the server, not just hidden in the interface.

shots.title: A tutor's workspace
shots.caption: No Finance, Schools, Marketing, BI or Administration in the menu; the dashboard shows only what a tutor may see.

shots.title: Direct link to Finance
shots.caption: Typing the URL doesn't help: the server refuses and shows Access denied.
